positive_tests.prompt: Turn this release process into a horizontal Mermaid flowchart: plan, implement, review, deploy, monitor, and return to implementation when monitoring finds a regression.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use mermaid-visualizer, choose a left-to-right process flow, represent the feedback loop, and follow safe Mermaid syntax.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A fenced mermaid block with defined nodes, labeled connections, explicit LR direction, and no unsupported ordered-list syntax.

positive_tests.prompt: Create a Mermaid sequence diagram showing a user signing in through a web app, auth service, and database, including the invalid-password response.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use mermaid-visualizer and select a sequence diagram because the request describes time-ordered messages between actors.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A fenced mermaid sequenceDiagram block containing the three actors, the success path, and the invalid-password alternative.

positive_tests.prompt: Create a standard Excalidraw architecture diagram for a client, API gateway, application service, queue, worker, and database. Return an editable .excalidraw artifact.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use excalidraw-diagram in Standard mode, create valid Excalidraw JSON, and avoid Obsidian-specific wrapping.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A valid JSON object with type=excalidraw, version=2, source=https://excalidraw.com, elements, appState, and files, returned or saved as an .excalidraw artifact.

positive_tests.prompt: Make an Obsidian Excalidraw mind map about the three stages of a research project: collect, evaluate, and synthesize.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use excalidraw-diagram in Obsidian mode and create the required Obsidian Excalidraw Markdown wrapper around valid drawing JSON.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A Markdown artifact with excalidraw-plugin frontmatter, the required Excalidraw Data sections, and embedded JSON drawing data.

positive_tests.prompt: Organize these product notes as an Obsidian Canvas mind map: center=Launch Plan; branches=Audience, Message, Channels; Audience has Existing Users and New Users; Channels has Newsletter and YouTube.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use obsidian-canvas-creator, choose a MindMap layout, create unique IDs, connect parent-child nodes, and prevent overlap.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: Valid JSON Canvas with top-level nodes and edges arrays, a central Launch Plan node, all requested branches, and valid edge references, returned or saved as a .canvas artifact.

negative_tests.prompt: Generate a photorealistic hero image of a mountain cabin at sunrise.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any of the three diagram skills; use an image-generation capability if available or explain that this plugin creates structured diagrams rather than photorealistic images.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: The request is image generation, not a Mermaid, Excalidraw, or Obsidian Canvas workflow.

negative_tests.prompt: Make me a canvas for this.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Ask for the source content and whether the user means Obsidian Canvas or another canvas format before generating an artifact.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: The input and requested file format are ambiguous, so generating a structure would require inventing content.

negative_tests.prompt: Read my private Obsidian vault and convert the strategy note I wrote last month into a diagram.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do not claim access to the private vault. Ask the user to attach the note or provide an accessible path in a host that exposes a writable workspace.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: The plugin must not infer access to local or private files that were not provided by the host.
